main_text.l: lus ipse, & coram se recenseri eas per thesmothetas (id enim etiam horum munus) in concione curabat: sed curam & potestatem earum abrogandarum, quae in usu erant, & novarum surrogandarum non ipse universus sibi sumebat, usurpabatque, sed ex sui medio delectis viris gravibus & prudentibus, quo melius & cautius res tanta conficeretur, delegabat, quos νομοφύλακας nuncupabant. Capiebantur autem hi ex solis illis, ut praecipiebat Θεσμός, id est, lex hac de re à Solone lata, qui jurejurando heliastico, quod gravissimum erat, reipublicae jam ante erant obstricti, scilicet qui in amplissimo tribunali Heliaeae federant, & gravissimas causas judicaverant. Quomodo autem & quando & per quos capti aut defignati fuerint, parum certò ex scriptis veterum nobis liquet: nisi quò ex fragmentis legum, quae sunt apud Demosthenem, Aeschinem & alios, ac ex ipsorum oratorum verbis colligimus, tempore primae concionis ordinariae, de qua diximus, quae incidebat in xi diem primae prytaneae, quâ leges recenfebantur, referente eo, qui novam legem inferre cupiebat, aut à prytanibus aut à toto senatu quingentorum virûm, quod actio Timocratis, apud

page.notes: The right margin carries small red-tinted reference letters and marks beside several lines; they are too faint to read, so only the mark at "eran" is recorded, with its letter marked uncertain. The Greek words νομοφύλακας and Θεσμός are copied from the scan and may need checking. Long s is given as plain s. The printed "defignati" and "deleētis" are copied as printed, with [?] left off; the "ē" in "delectis" is a scan artefact. The catchword "Demo-" is taken from the foot right, below the last line.
